title: A theme drawn from the text itself
statement: Derive a text's theme from patterned details in that text, never from a moral the unit planned in advance.
detail: A Grade 5 reading course's curriculum graph lets a unit's related myths explore the consequences of ignoring limits, but says the exact theme must be derived from each text rather than imposed in advance. Its link from quoting evidence to theme requires patterned support in the text rather than a free-floating moral, and its task comparing two tellings of a myth explains a shared pattern without imposing a universal moral. These are definitions in a design graph; no outcome was measured.

evidence.quote: the exact theme must be derived from each text rather than imposed in advance.
Theme claims require patterned textual support rather than a free-floating moral.
